components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single amber action; blocky, press-ready, near-black text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #ffb52e; color: #120c00; font: 400 14px/1 'Schibsted Grotesk', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.01em; padding: 14px 24px; border: 0; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.16s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #ffc75e; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffb52e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action; outlined in dim amber, brightens on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #ece9e1; font: 400 14px/1 'Schibsted Grotesk', sans-serif; padding: 14px 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(209,143,27,0.6); border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: box-shadow 0.16s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,181,46,0.35); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffb52e; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Dot-matrix live/demo signal; green pulse for live, amber for demo.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font: 400 10px/1.4 'DotGothic16', monospace; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #5aff9a; } .ds-chip-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; box-shadow: 0 0 8px currentColor; animation: ds-blink 1.4s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-blink { 0%,100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.35; } }

components.name: Board Row
components.description: A ruled showtime row: film, time, screen, seats left, price, and Book.
components.html: The Grand Adventure6:00 PMAUD 0194Rp 50.000
components.css: .ds-board-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) 64px 92px 52px 84px 62px; gap: 10px; align-items: center; padding: 10px 2px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(236,233,225,0.07); font-family: 'Schibsted Grotesk', sans-serif; color: #ece9e1; background: transparent; } .ds-board-row:first-child { background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,181,46,0.12), transparent 62%); box-shadow: inset 2px 0 0 #ffb52e; } .ds-mono { font-family: 'DotGothic16', monospace; font-size: 13px; } .ds-dim { color: #a6a29a; } .ds-green { color: #5aff9a; } .ds-book { font: 400 11px/1 'Schibsted Grotesk', sans-serif; padding: 6px 10px; background: #ffb52e; color: #120c00; border: 0; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; }

components.name: Seat
components.description: Discrete seat button; states swap outline, fill, and glow.
components.css: .ds-seat { width: 22px; height: 24px; border: 1px solid rgba(236,233,225,0.14); background: transparent; border-radius: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.12s ease, background-color 0.12s ease, box-shadow 0.12s ease; } .ds-seat:hover { border-color: #ffb52e; box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(255,181,46,0.25); } .ds-seat--selected { background: #ffb52e; border-color: #ffb52e; box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255,181,46,0.55); } .ds-seat:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ffb52e; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Board Panel Frame
components.description: The signature board: corner brackets, gradient panel, ticker, hold countdown.
components.html:
Tonight at CinX
Seat G7 held for you 4:51
components.css: .ds-board { position: relative; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #15151b, #0e0e12); border: 1px solid rgba(236,233,225,0.14); padding: 18px; box-shadow: 0 30px 80px -30px rgba(0,0,0,0.8), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.04); } .ds-board::before, .ds-board::after { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 14px; height: 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(209,143,27,0.5); } .ds-board::before { top: -1px; left: -1px; border-right: 0; border-bottom: 0; } .ds-board::after { bottom: -1px; right: -1px; border-left: 0; border-top: 0; } .ds-board-title { font: 400 13px/1 'DotGothic16', monospace; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #ece9e1; } .ds-hold { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; padding: 14px 2px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(236,233,225,0.07); font: 400 12px/1 'DotGothic16', monospace; letter-spacing: 0.06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #ffb52e; } .ds-count { margin-left: auto; font-size: 22px; color: #ece9e1; text-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(255,181,46,0.4); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview: CinX is a cinema ticketing service where the schedule board is the product, not a decoration. Every surface is a lit departure board at the cinema: near-black matte panels, amber dot-matrix lettering, bone-white body text, phosphor-green 'live' marks, and rows, columns, and tickers ruled with the precision of an arrivals display. The hero refuses the dark-poster-grid cinema trope; instead the hero IS a live showtime board with a ticking seat-hold countdown, so a first-time visitor reads the entire offer in one scan — this books seats, holds them for five minutes, and never double-sells. The density is informational and mechanical: uppercase dot-matrix labels, ruled column headers, ticker tape, blinking live dots, corner-bracketed panels. Personality comes from the board's own grammar (glow, pulse, countdown, NOW chips), never from decorative flourish. The palette is night-cinema dark with a single warm amber accent that carries all primary actions, a phosphor green reserved for 'live/available' signals, and bone-white for text on the matte black.
keyCharacteristics: Every surface is a board: panels carry the corner-bracket motif, ruled borders, and dot-matrix labels of a departure display.
Amber is the single action color; it never competes with the green 'live' signal.
Type is two voices: DotGothic16 for all data/board/labels, Schibsted Grotesk for comfortable long-form body reading.
Sharp corners throughout (0 radius); depth comes from soft ambient shadow and glow, never from bevels or offset block shadows.
Motion is the board's own: ticker scroll, dot-pulse blink, hold countdown, row reveal, cursor blink — one authored moment per mechanism, never scattered.

rules.name: The Single Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber is the only action color and it is used sparingly — primary buttons, selected/held states, the brand mark. When something must 'press' or is 'held', it is amber; everything else stays neutral. Rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Green Means Live Rule
rules.body: Phosphor green is a signal, never an action. Green says 'this is happening now / this seat is available'; it never carries a button.

rules.name: The Board Voice Rule
rules.body: Numbers, times, prices, seat counts, ticket codes, and all uppercase labels are set in DotGothic16 with tabular-nums behavior where they tick. The display face is never used for body-length copy, and the body face is never used for data.

rules.name: The Halo Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Light is a colored glow with zero offset; depth is a soft blur with offset. A hard offset block shadow is foreign to this world and never appears — this is not neobrutalist, and a costume block-shadow is a violation.

dos: Do set every number, time, price, seat label, and uppercase board label in DotGothic16.
Do reserve amber for the single action or the held/selected state, and green for live/available signals.
Do keep corners at 0 radius and rule surfaces with 1px line borders and the corner-bracket motif.
Do express light as zero-offset colored glow, and depth as soft offset shadow with blur.
donts: Don't use a dark-poster-grid cinema hero — the schedule board IS the hero, with a live hold countdown.
Don't use hard offset block shadows, bevels, or embossed material — the world is matte boards, not stamped metal.
Don't use gradient text, glass, or blur as decoration; the only blur is the board bar's backdrop and text glows.
Don't put an eyebrow/kicker above a heading — the board label above a title is part of the board, never a section label.
Don't use a system display face (Impact, Arial Black, platform sans) — DotGothic16 is the board voice.
Don't use glyph icons or emoji — all icons are authored SVG in one 1.3–1.5px stroke weight.
